{{Quote|The royal family wanted to heal relations between the Rift Alliance and the Republic, they thought donating troops would help. They planned a ceremony on Waypoint Station Three to present you with the soldiers. But you were needed on Hoth... so I sent Blaesus as our envoy. He's with the king and queen right now.|Senator [[Tobas Grell]]|<ref name="TOR:CtL">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Chasing the Legend|Hoth}}</ref>}}
'''Waypoint Station Three''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. During the [[Galactic War]], the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Mission to Waypoint Station Three|confronted]] and killed [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]] [[Augin Blaesus]] there and rescued [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sethun]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Nyscha]] of [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]].<ref name="TOR" />
